Masar Petroleum

Masar Petroleum is a dynamic and forward-thinking oil and gas exploration and production company that began operations in 2015. With a strategic focus on unlocking hydrocarbon resources to meet the world's growing energy demands, Masar Petroleum owns 100% of Block 7 in Sahmah, a significant asset with immense potential for exploration and production activities.
